```python
# filename: compute_percentage_increase.py
funds = [
    {"Fund Name":"Fidelity Emerging Markets Index Fund", "Ticker":"FPADX", "NAV_May_2019":11.60, "NAV_May_2024":12.90, "Transaction_Fee":"$0"},
    {"Fund Name":"Fidelity Emerging Markets Fund", "Ticker":"FEMKX", "NAV_May_2019":25.30, "NAV_May_2024":26.80, "Transaction_Fee":"$0"},
    {"Fund Name":"Fidelity Emerging Markets Discovery Fund", "Ticker":"FEDDX", "NAV_May_2019":18.00, "NAV_May_2024":20.00, "Transaction_Fee":"$0"}
]

results = []
for f in funds:
    start = f["NAV_May_2019"]
    end = f["NAV_May_2024"]
    pct = ((end - start) / start) * 100.0
    f_out = {
        "Fund Name": f["Fund Name"],
        "Ticker": f["Ticker"],
        "Percentage Increase": round(pct, 2),
        "Transaction Fee": f["Transaction_Fee"]
    }
    results.append(f_out)

# Identify lowest percentage increase
lowest = min(results, key=lambda x: x["Percentage Increase"])

print("Results:")
for r in results:
    print(r)
print("Lowest:", lowest)
```
